connector.name: FAQai
connector.registryDescription: Turn any document into a production-ready RAG dataset from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP host.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.faqai, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FAQAI_API_KEY
env.description: FAQai API key (requires a paid plan). Create one at https://faqai.app/settings/api-keys

env.name: FAQAI_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the FAQai API base URL (defaults to https://faqai.app). Rarely needed.
